jobs.title: Client Portfolio Manager (Equities)
jobs.description:
Why work for us?

A career at Janus Henderson is more than a job, it’s about investing  in a brighter future together.

Our Mission at Janus Henderson is to help clients define and achieve superior financial outcomes through differentiated insights, disciplined investments, and world-class service. We will do this by protecting and growing our core business, amplifying our strengths and diversifying where we have the right.

Our Values are key to driving our success, and are at the heart of everything we do:

Clients Come First - Always | Execution Supersedes Intention | Together We Win | Diversity Improves Results | Truth Builds Trust

If our mission, values, and purpose align with your own, we would love to hear from you!

Your opportunity

- Responsible for growing Janus Henderson’s equity strategies through proactive engagement with clients, prospects, and sales teams

- Responsible for driving the commercial success of covered products through business plan ownership, completion and implementation

- Work closely with the CPM leadership to develop, articulate, and communicate longer-term business plan goals and targets to internal stakeholders

- Represent and advocate for the Portfolio Managers both within the organisation and with the external client base; display expertise in articulating team philosophy, process, performance/attribution and portfolio positioning to internal and external clients

- Participate in regular investment discussions with portfolio managers and analysts.

- Engage with Portfolio Managers to ensure that investment strategy aligns with client expectations and guidelines across market environments to provide excellent client experience

- Drive distribution strategy to support new business and asset retention efforts with key accounts; activities will include internal strategy discussions, pro-active sales engagement, final RFP review for custom or large opportunities, PR

- Provide investment voice in the product messaging, marketing strategy, and development of collateral material

- Represent Janus Henderson Investors (JHI) across the industry, building our reputation and brand through participation in client conferences and investment panels

- Engage with product development on future strategy of product set; including competitor analysis, fees and positioning

- Assist in client prospecting across all geographies and Distribution channels where necessary

- Carry out other duties as assigned

What to expect when you join our firm

- Hybrid working and reasonable accommodations

- Generous Holiday policies

- Excellent Health and Wellbeing benefits including corporate membership to ClassPass

- Paid volunteer time to step away from your desk and into the community

- Support to grow through professional development courses, tuition/qualification reimbursement and more

- All-inclusive approach to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

- Maternal/paternal leave benefits and family services

- Complimentary subscription to Headspace – the mindfulness app

- All employee events including networking opportunities and social activities

- Lunch allowance for use within our subsidized onsite canteen

Must have skills

- Degree in a relevant subject such as finance, business, economics or equivalent work experience required

- 10+ years equity or fixed income investment experience as a client portfolio manager, investment director, research analyst, portfolio manager, strategist, or equivalent

- Extensive knowledge of relevant sector/product/instruments for the role

- Strong knowledge of macro and market trends with the ability to represent strategy views

- Ability to understand data related to portfolio attribution, contribution and risk measures

- Strong commercial instincts, executive presence, presentation skills, and ability to influence across internal and external stakeholders

- Client Skills – able to write and report for a variety of audiences, adapting key messages by client type, and presenting and communicating with clients clearly and confidently

- Track record of partnering effectively with sales, product, portfolio management, marketing, and leadership teams to drive business outcomes

- Agility – able to respond effectively to changing environments, and proactively find ways to provide innovative solutions for clients and teams

- Teamwork - ability to work cooperatively within a team environment

- Travel as needed

- Data interpretation from institutional sources including: Bloomberg, FactSet, Wilshire, Zephyr, Investor Force-PSN, Callan PEP software, etc.

Nice to have skills

- Advanced degree or CFA Charter Holder preferred

Investment areas

- Has responsibility for supporting portfolios within Equities

Supervisory responsibilities

- No

Potential for growth

- Mentoring

- Leadership development programs

- Regular training

- Career development services

- Continuing education courses

You will be expected to understand the regulatory obligations of the firm, and abide by the regulated entity requirements and JHI policies applicable for your role.

jobs.description:

A career at Janus Henderson is more than a job, it’s about investing  in a brighter future together.

Clients Come First - Always | Execution Supersedes Intention | Together We Win | Diversity Improves Results | Truth Builds Trust

If our mission, values, and purpose align with your own, we would love to hear from you!
Your opportunity

Janus Henderson manages over $500Bil in AUM across 27 offices globally. With more than 350 investment professionals, our Investment Management department has some of the industry's most talented and innovative thinkers, spanning equities, fixed income, multi-asset, and alternatives. Our investment teams blend insight, originality, and precision, with rigorous analysis, structured processes, and robust risk management. They seek to be at the forefront of anticipating and adapting to change to deliver market-leading, risk-adjusted returns.

You will complete a two-year immersion within our Equity investment team commencing in Summer 2027. The programme is designed to provide you with:

- Exposure to our various strategies and teams within the equities department with the opportunity to learn how companies and capital markets drive the global economy

- The opportunity to learn the fundamentals of equity research, including quantitative financial analysis and qualitative due diligence, while working alongside some of the best professionals in the industry

- Training provided as a combination of ‘on-the-job’ and formal learning. Both soft skills (e.g. presentation skills) and technical skills (e.g. modelling, Bloomberg) will be developed

- Relevant professional qualifications – full sponsorship for you to complete the CFA and granting you study leaves to prepare for the exams

- Exposure to a variety of company management teams and general investment team meetings

- The ability to immediately contribute our investment process working alongside experienced analysts and portfolio managers and be a valued member of the investment team

Research Associates who excel in the role will be considered for a permanent position and promotion to Associate Analyst upon completion of the programme.

- Hybrid working and reasonable accommodations

- Generous Holiday policies

- Paid volunteer time to step away from your desk and into the community

- Lunch allowance for use within our subsidized onsite canteen

Must have skills

- You must have graduated from an Undergraduate or Masters degree in 2026 or be graduating in 2027 and be available to start full time work from September 2027

- A long-term interest in investing, financial markets and business

- Passionate about providing excellent client service

- Intellectual curiosity and strong analytical reasoning

- Excellent communication skills

- Desire to work and succeed within a collaborative team

- Highly numerate with great attention to detail

- Open minded / curious and willing to ask questions

Nice to have skills

- Previous finance-related internship/experience preferred

- MS Excel experience

- Python, Power BI, AI

Supervisory responsibilities

- No

Potential for growth

- Mentoring

- Leadership development programs

- Regular training

- Career development services

- Continuing education courses

For those in scope of Knowledge & Competence (MiFID II)

- Knowledge of financial markets, financial markets function and the impact of economic figures and national/regional/global events on markets

- Understanding of issues relating to market abuse and anti-money laundering

- Annual attestation

Recruitment timeline

This role will be open for applications until Saturday, 31 October 2026. You are required to submit your CV and complete the additional questions. Online assessments and video interview will be conducted throughout October and November. We anticipate the assessment centre will be held in December and will be making offers by January 2027 .

jobs.title: Research Analyst, Long-Short - Technology
jobs.description:
Why work for us?

A career at Janus Henderson is more than a job, it’s about investing in a brighter future together .

Our Mission at Janus Henderson is to help clients define and achieve superior financial outcomes through differentiated insights, disciplined investments, and world-class service. We will do this by protecting and growing our core business, amplifying our strengths and diversifying where we have the right.

Clients Come First - Always | Execution Supersedes Intention | Together We Win | Diversity Improves Results | Truth Builds Trust

If our mission, values, and purpose align with your own, we would love to hear from you!

Your opportunity

- Conduct rigorous, bottom-up fundamental research across the technology sector to generate differentiated long and short investment ideas

- Develop and maintain detailed financial models to assess business quality, competitive positioning, earnings power, cash-flow generation, valuation, catalysts and downside risk

- Identify attractive long and short investment opportunities by evaluating company fundamentals, industry structure, technology cycles, management quality, capital allocation and market expectations

- Build deep sector expertise through company meetings, industry conferences, expert networks, channel checks and engagement with competitors, customers, suppliers and other relevant market participants

- Communicate investment recommendations clearly and persuasively to Portfolio Managers through concise written research, investment notes, model outputs and verbal presentations

- Monitor existing positions, sector developments and emerging risks, providing timely updates on thesis progression, catalysts, valuation changes and risk/reward dynamics

- Contribute to portfolio discussions, risk reviews and broader investment team priorities, supporting a collaborative and performance-oriented research culture

What to expect when you join our firm

- Hybrid working and reasonable accommodations

- Generous Holiday policies

- Excellent Health and Wellbeing benefits including corporate membership to Wellhub

- Unique employee events and programs including a 14er challenge

- Complimentary beverages, snacks and all employee Happy Hours

Must have skills

- 7-10 years of equity investment research experience, with exposure to long/short or hedge fund-style investing

- Four-year degree in finance, economics, accounting, engineering, computer science or a related discipline

- Post-graduate degree such as an MBA, or progress towards/completion of CFA and/or CPA qualifications

- Prior experience covering technology companies within a long/short equity, hedge fund, asset management or equity research environment

- Strong understanding of short-selling mechanics, including borrow availability, short interest, stock loan dynamics, crowded positioning, and short squeeze risk

- Experience analyzing software, semiconductors, internet, hardware, IT services or related technology subsectors

- Demonstrated ability to generate high-conviction long and short investment ideas supported by differentiated research, clear catalysts and thoughtful risk/reward analysis

- Strong understanding of technology business models, industry structures, competitive dynamics and key sector drivers

- Advanced financial modelling skills, including the ability to forecast revenue, margins, earnings, cash flows, valuation scenarios and sensitivity analyses

- Strong analytical judgement, intellectual curiosity and attention to detail, with the ability to distinguish signal from noise in complex and fast-moving markets

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present investment views clearly, concisely and persuasively

- Ability to work independently, take ownership of research coverage and make informed recommendations while contributing effectively within a collaborative investment team

- Strong interpersonal skills and credibility with company management teams, industry contacts and internal stakeholders

- High level of integrity, sound judgement and commitment to delivering strong outcomes for clients

- Established network of industry contacts and familiarity with alternative data, expert networks or channel-check research techniques

Investment areas

- Supports Janus Henderson’s centralized US equity research platform, with primary responsibility for technology sector coverage across long/short equity portfolios

- No

- Leadership development programs

- Regular training

- Career development services

- Continuing education courses
